scope: observation only; no simulation, engine/card/calibration changes or candidate combination; all four seasons seen/in-sample
source: same game/sample exclusions and anchor references as oreb-clock14-1; process original action array order, never sort by actionNumber; no new season downloads

states.reset: explicit current/past evidence of rim/ring contact in shot/rebound structured fields or unambiguous contact text; all FG offensive rebounds alone insufficient
states.retain: explicit current/past no-rim/airball evidence; blocked alone insufficient
states.unknown: neither, contradictory contact evidence, or nonidentifiable reference; retain both reset14 and remaining-clock possibilities

chronology.fresh24: confirmed individual defensive rebound of a valid missed FG or live final FT; official turnover establishes next team24 at its current clock. Period start unknown without opening control evidence. Made FG opens uncertain inbound delay rather than exact24
chronology.elapsed: subtract game-clock elapsed from known bounds within period. Uncertain bounds retained, no inferred point estimate; timestamp reversal or inconsistent ownership invalidates state until fresh evidence
chronology.fgMiss: carry pre-existing clock through flight until rebound; rim unknown keeps reset14 and retained-clock branches. Made FG and ordinary FT stop old clock; made FG inbound start uncertain; no hidden fixed inbound seconds
chronology.fouls: ordinary defensive personal/looseball where penalty/frontcourt unresolved uses union including carry/max14/backcourt24 as applicable; shooting/technical/unknown foul not treated as confirmed14; no later FT looked ahead to classify
chronology.unknownEvents: jumpball or unresolved possession/clock corrections widen/invalidate clock; timeout/substitution alone do not imply reset
chronology.noRimRule: never assume every block is no-rim or every unblocked miss hits rim; do not use following violation or timing to choose an earlier branch

outputs: exact anchor reset/retain/unknown counts and coverage, all anchors plus first anchors
pre-rebound remaining-clock interval informativeness and fresh evidence sources
first endpoint time support for reset vs retain branches; use endpoint only for validation, no relabeling past anchors
held-out clock-event validation: interval residual/error bounds only, never claim actual shot-clock MAE without an independent shot-clock trace
timestamp/ownership failures, source-action references and failure list
franchise bootstrap95 for descriptive rates; real data only so seed uncertainty inapplicable
stop: one batch then report facts/inference/failures; insufficient identification explicitly reported, no invented event rate
